mechanisms.decisive_claim: The exact density D_k forces an allowed representative below C/D_k for an absolute C.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compare exact first representatives with D_k and construct generic CRT systems of the same local densities having arbitrarily delayed first representatives.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A Paley-Zygmund bound for a random translated H-window implies the fixed initial window (2k,H] is nonempty.
mechanisms.kill_test: Write the quantifiers of the translation average and exhibit an exceptional empty translate despite a positive average nonempty probability.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Control of all pair correlations J_k(h) for h<=H bounds the maximum survivor gap by O(1/D_k).
mechanisms.kill_test: Test periodic binary sets with the same density and pair-correlation envelope but a distinguished long gap; audit the missing fixed-shift step.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Ordinary inclusion-exclusion using every modulus d<=H recovers the product density D_k when H=exp(Ck/log k).
mechanisms.kill_test: Compare the maximum support size log H/log k with the number of prime constraints and quantify the unresolved dense binomial tail.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Products of a sublinear number of selected primes in (k,2k) supply enough candidates to satisfy every remaining congruence while staying exp(O(k/log k)).
mechanisms.kill_test: Compare candidate entropy log binomial(m,t), output magnitude t log k, and the roughly m-t surviving one-bit constraints.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A bounded-overlap dual weighting of the forbidden congruence classes proves that their union cannot cover the initial interval beyond C/D_k.
mechanisms.kill_test: Solve the exact fractional cover on small instances and reject weights whose normalization uses translation average rather than the initial prefix.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Replacing a single short prime interval by several coupled intervals in the Konyagin encoding strictly improves the constant 1/20 in the exponent of the known lower bound.
mechanisms.kill_test: Audit height, degree and prime-interval losses from arXiv:2606.19863 and test whether extra intervals increase polynomial height faster than the gained prime supply.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Optimising the admissible short-prime exponent theta in the existing proof improves the exponent constant without new prime-gap input.
mechanisms.kill_test: Symbolically retain theta through every inequality and identify whether the published theta=21/40 already saturates a competing constraint.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Quotient-stable block decomposition contracts the fixed-prefix discrepancy while losing o(k/log k) in the exponent.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute boundary counts on successive H-scales and kill if the accumulated exceptional blocks have exponential cost comparable to D_k^{-1}.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The Lovasz local lemma applied to a random integer in [1,H] overcomes the dense congruence constraints at H=exp(O(k/log k)).
mechanisms.kill_test: Build the event dependency graph; kill if every event depends on every other through the single random variable n.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A classical large-sieve inequality for the allowed residue sets gives a positive survivor count at H=exp(O(k/log k)).
mechanisms.kill_test: Insert the total removed-residue mass and compare the large-sieve denominator with H; kill if the inequality only produces an upper bound or has negative denominator.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Agreement of exact n_k values with the density scale through a large finite cutoff certifies n_k=exp((log 4+o(1))k/log k).
mechanisms.kill_test: Check whether the computation includes a proved reduction from all k to the finite range; kill on absence of such a reduction.
